title: FBI-UAP-D010, FD-302-71, “Northeastern Orb Sighting,” 2026
what_is_it: An FBI FD-302 interview report documenting a first-hand witness account of unidentified anomalous phenomena (orb sightings) in the northeastern United States.
core_summary: An FBI FD-302 records an interview with a U.S. person who observed two luminous orbs (one basketball-sized, one beach-ball-sized) approximately 30 yards away and 20-30 feet above the ground near their home at around 9:15pm. A second witness also observed the objects move laterally before one orb appeared to merge into the other and both abruptly disappeared. The primary witness reported additional sightings weeks later of white orbs traveling at higher altitude, and recalled a separate 1987 sighting of a red light near power lines.
interpretation_warnings: Heavy redaction: all witness names, specific dates, and precise locations are redacted throughout the document.
Single-source account: the primary observations come from one witness, with partial corroboration from one additional person.
The 1987 sighting is recalled from memory decades later and is unverified.
OCR artifacts in the source text introduce minor uncertainties in some quoted passages.
The document explicitly states it contains neither recommendations nor conclusions of the FBI.
No photographic evidence is included in the released text, though photos are referenced as attachments.

public_headline: FBI Interview Records Witness Account of Luminous Orbs in Northeastern US
public_tldr: This FBI FD-302 interview report documents a witness who observed two luminous orbs — one basketball-sized, one beach-ball-sized — hovering near their home in the northeastern United States around 9:15pm in 2025. The document is heavily redacted, contains no FBI conclusions, and relies primarily on a single witness account with partial corroboration from one other person.
public_narrative:
This document is an FBI FD-302, a standard form used to record witness interviews. It captures a first-hand account from a person in the northeastern United States who reported seeing unidentified anomalous phenomena near their home in 2025.

The witness stated that upon arriving home around 9:15pm, they noticed a yellow ball of light roughly the size of a basketball through their windshield. Shortly after, they saw a second, larger ball of light about the size of a beach ball. Both objects were approximately 30 yards away and 20 to 30 feet above the ground. A second person came outside and also observed the objects. Both witnesses watched the orbs move laterally to the left, passing behind trees and a neighbour's house. At some point, one orb appeared to merge into the other before both abruptly vanished. The primary witness reported no health issues or eye discomfort from watching the lights.

Weeks later, the same witness reported seeing white orbs travelling from west to east at a higher altitude. The witness also recalled a separate 1987 sighting of a red light near power lines, which they described as resembling the front of the car from the television show Knight Rider. They said the object hovered and then landed near a power station.

The FBI document states explicitly that it contains neither recommendations nor conclusions from the bureau. Photos were taken by FBI agents at the scene with the witness's permission, but no photographic evidence is included in the released text — they are referenced only as attachments. All witness names, specific dates, and precise locations are redacted throughout.
